title: Creation and the Covenant of Works
subtitle: Genesis 1-3
theme: Who is God, and what is man? The foundations of all Christian doctrine.
memoryText: In the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth.
reviewQuestions: What does the order and goodness of creation reveal about God’s character?
What was the nature of the covenant God made with Adam in the garden?
What did the Fall change about the relationship between God and humanity?
Where is the first promise of redemption in Scripture, and what does it tell us?
psalmsNote: Creation psalms (8, 19:1-6, 29, 33:1-9, 65, and 104) answer Genesis 1 and 2 with praise.
